rule: plan 90 §90.3.1 with design general/topics/relevant, howdecided, prominent, howto, workup/choose; keys = signed EORS em general (SD_GEN_ALL: labs, ekg, imaging, anatomy, procedures, guidelines, screenings, workup); PAEA Emergency Medicine 2026 topic list (scratch/em/em-2026.pdf); Leader S10 ruling: selection recorded here, general.json written in S12

workupNotes: Alphabetical by title in the published list. Presentations her EM guide has notes on as presentations: Dyspnea on exertion, Edema, Palpitations (cardio; endocrinology), Hemoptysis, Hematuria/flank pain (HEMATURIA, SUPRAPUBIC/FLANK PAIN), Eye pain/vision loss (VISION LOSS), Ear pain (Ear Pain), Nasal congestion (NASAL CONGESTION), Tremors (TREMORS), Loss of coordination/ataxia (Loss of Coordination/Ataxia), Nausea/vomiting (her GI symptom table titled 'Nausea/Vomiting', DDx and anti-emetics), plus Orthopnea folded into Shortness of breath. The rest are usual presentations of EM-list conditions.
